patch_description: Replace the single pressure-first construction with several deterministic greedy starts and retain the best complete placement before local improvement. Model placement is sensitive to ordering: pressure-first distributes load well but can fragment memory, while size-first and hard-to-place-first preserve feasible regions for large models. Each start still chooses the GPU with the minimum resulting global maximum KVPR. Selecting the best completed start improves the local search starting point without changing the output format or permitting memory overcommitment.
